mentions.name: Atomically Precise Manufacturing
mentions.description: This project develops atomically precise manufacturing: a 3D printing method that places silicon and diamond atoms one at a time with every atom bonded where intended. At small scales it enables precise nanophotonic and quantum devices with precisely placed defect centers in silicon, with a roadmap toward bootstrapping full molecular nanotechnology and scaling to industrial levels.
mentions.source_excerpt: Atomically precise manufacturing. We are perfecting a method for 3D printing silicon & diamond atom-by-atom, with every atom bonded where you want it. At small scales this gets us precise nanophotonic and quantum devices with precisely placed defect centers in silicon. As we scale, we will bootstrap full molecular nanotechnology including replicative scale-up to industrial levels.
